say:1:1423417001:1.text: There's word that some of Velara's people fled to Molten Abyss. I'm worried they're up to something.
say:1:1423417001:1.source_cn: 我接到线报，奎茵的部分残党潜逃至了炎息沉渊，我担心她们...

say:2:1423417002:1.text: Indris was supposed to handle it... but he's just as tied up as I am. I'll need you to make a trip to Molten Abyss for us.
say:2:1423417002:1.source_cn: 这本该是因度厄的工作……但他和我一样脱不开身，要拜托你...
